svg.title: Exoplanet habitability in three movements: a survey satellite staring at a star while its camera collects the light; the light becoming flux readings that dip by about one percent; and the system itself, a planet on an eccentric Kepler orbit transiting a limb-darkened star, its light curve computed for a planet a tenth of the star's radius. Do habitability indices reduce to a few physical quantities?
